items.source_title: Didactic orchestration integrating artificial intelligence tools to develop creative thinking skills in students
items.source_locator: 出版社文章頁（frontiersin.org，2026-11-20 讀取 200）：Published 19 November 2026（citation_online_date 10/23 為接受日，不採用）；摘要歸屬：Introduction 第 1 句、Methods 第 1 句、Discussion 第 2、3 句
items.original_excerpt: This study examined changes in students' self-reported creativity-related behaviors following an educational intervention combining artificial intelligence (AI) tools and the DRAE instructional model (Diagnosis, Recreation, Application, and Estimation). … A one-group preexperimental pretest-posttest questionnaire design was complemented by semi-structured interviews and direct-observation records. … However, retrospective record linkage, limitations in cross-instrument correspondence, self-report measurement, and the absence of a comparison group restrict causal interpretation. … The findings do not establish an independent causal effect of AI or validate the DRAE model.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Frontiers in Education（Frontiers）；資料標題：Didactic orchestration integrating artificial intelligence tools to develop creative thinking skills in students；來源刊登日：2026-11-19。作者摘要報告：研究探討結合 AI 工具與 DRAE 教學模式的教育介入後，學生自陳的創造力相關行為變化，採單組前後測問卷設計，輔以半結構訪談與直接觀察紀錄；作者說明回溯式紀錄串連、測量工具間對應的限制、自陳測量與缺乏對照組限制了推論，研究結果不足以確立 AI 的獨立作用，也未驗證 DRAE 模式。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
items.scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Frontiers in Education，監測清單 J29）；表 1 學段為小學 15.2%、中學 80.4%、技術 4.0%，依多數標 K-12；單組前後測、自陳測量、無對照組，介入成效不寫入。

items.source_title: Socioeconomic Status and AI Use for Schoolwork in Relation to Adolescents’ School Belonging and Loneliness in Four Chinese Regions
items.source_locator: 出版社 PDF（管理者 2026-11-21 提供；自動讀取回 403）：Published: 19 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 3、4、8 句
items.original_excerpt: This study used cross-sectional PISA data from adolescents in four Chinese regions. … Unweighted multiple linear regression analyses examined economic, social and cultural status (ESCS) and AI use for schoolwork in relation to school loneliness and school belonging. … Higher ESCS and more frequent AI use for schoolwork were associated with lower school loneliness and greater school belonging.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Behavioral Sciences（MDPI）；資料標題：Socioeconomic Status and AI Use for Schoolwork in Relation to Adolescents’ School Belonging and Loneliness in Four Chinese Regions；來源刊登日：2026-11-19。作者摘要報告：研究使用中國四個地區青少年的 PISA 橫斷面資料，以未加權多元線性迴歸分析經濟、社會與文化地位（ESCS）及課業 AI 使用，與學校孤獨感、學校歸屬感的關聯；作者指出，較高的 ESCS 與較頻繁的課業 AI 使用，和較低的學校孤獨感及較高的學校歸屬感相關。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

items.source_title: This study examines the factors associated with Chinese secondary school teachers’ intentions to teach artificial intelligence using structural equation modeling and machine learning

items.original_excerpt: In response to this research gap, the present study expands the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) by integrating AI literacy, facilitating conditions and AI anxiety, thereby developing a more integrative motivational framework for investigating teachers’ intentions to teach AI. … Using cross-sectional survey data from 218 secondary school information technology teachers, covariance-based structural equation modeling was employed to test the hypothesized relationships. … Machine learning classification analyses were additionally conducted to examine the predictive performance of the theoretically relevant variables.

items.source_title: Examining Educators’ Interpretations of Cognitive Engagement in AI-Supported Instruction
items.source_locator: 出版社文章頁截圖（管理者 2026-11-21 提供；自動讀取回 403）：First published online November 19, 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2、3、7 句
items.original_excerpt: This study examined educators’ interpretations of AI-supported instructional scenarios using the Inversion, Substitution, Augmentation, and Redefinition (ISAR) model as an interpretive lens. … A total of 104 educators evaluated four vignette-based scenarios and rated each across all ISAR dimensions. … Findings highlight implications for teacher preparation, professional learning, and instructional decision-making about AI-supported learning in inclusive education.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Journal of Special Education Technology（Sage）；資料標題：Examining Educators’ Interpretations of Cognitive Engagement in AI-Supported Instruction；來源刊登日：2026-11-19。作者摘要報告：研究以反轉、替代、擴增與重新定義（ISAR）模型為詮釋框架，探討教育工作者如何詮釋 AI 輔助的教學情境；共 104 名教育工作者評估四個情境短文，並就每個情境在所有 ISAR 面向上評分；作者表示，研究結果對師資培育、專業學習，以及融合教育中 AI 輔助學習的教學決策具有意涵。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

items.source_title: MS·Google·AWS와 손잡고 교사의 인공지능(AI)·융합교육 역량을 키운다
items.source_locator: 韓國教育部 보도자료頁（2026-11-21 讀取 200）：單篇頁日期 2026-11-20，附件 hwpx「배포 2026. 11. 20.(금) 08:00」；摘要歸屬：本文第 1 至 4 段（各段單句）
items.original_excerpt: 교육부(장관 최교진)와 한국과학창의재단(이사장 정우성)은 11월 21일(토)부터 12월 5일(토)까지 마이크로소프트(MS)·구글(Google)·아마존웹서비스(AWS) 사옥에서 「인공지능(AI)·융합교육 교사연구회 역량강화 공동연수」를 개최한다. … 이번 공동연수는 세계적인 기업의 인공지능(AI) 기술을 학교 수업과 연계하여, ‘인공지능(AI)·융합교육 교사연구회’ 참여 교사가 인공지능(AI) 수업 설계·운영 역량을 강화할 수 있도록 지원하기 위해 마련되었다. … 참가 대상은 2026년 인공지능(AI)·융합교육 교사연구회 소속 교사 중 참가 희망자와 시도교육청의 인공지능(AI)·융합교육 담당자 등 약 240명이다. … 교사들은 기업별 사옥을 방문해 현직 인공지능(AI) 전문가들과 함께 첨단 인공지능(AI) 도구를 활용해 보고, 교실 수업에 적용할 수 있는 교수학습 자료를 제작하는 등 실습형 과정에 참여한다.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：韓國教育部；資料標題：MS·Google·AWS와 손잡고 교사의 인공지능(AI)·융합교육 역량을 키운다；來源刊登日：2026-11-20。官方文件表示：韓國教育部與韓國科學創意財團於 11 月 21 日至 12 月 5 日在微軟、Google、AWS 大樓舉辦 AI・融合教育教師研究會能力強化聯合研習，結合企業 AI 技術支持教師強化 AI 教學設計與運作能力；對象為 2026 年研究會中有意參加的教師及各市、道教育主管單位承辦人等約 240 人，教師將與現職 AI 專家試用先進 AI 工具並製作課堂教材。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

items.source_title: AI leadership readiness profiles and competence gaps among school leaders during digital transformation: a comparative study of China and Kazakhstan
items.source_locator: 出版社文章頁（frontiersin.org，2026-11-21 讀取 200）：Published 20 November 2026（citation_online_date 10/30 為接受日，不採用）；摘要歸屬：Introduction 第 2 句、Methods 第 1 句、Discussion 第 1、3 句
items.original_excerpt: This cross-national study examined AI leadership readiness in China and Kazakhstan, focusing on scenario understanding, instructional value, risk concern, digital leadership self-efficacy, organizational support, leadership support for adoption, implementation readiness, and competence gaps. … We analyzed a cross-national quantitative survey of 763 school leaders (China n = 389; Kazakhstan n = 374) using reliability analysis, measurement invariance testing, latent profile analysis, standardized recursive path modeling, and importance–competence gap analysis. … Positive instructional appraisals frequently coexisted with moderate school-level preparation. … Ethics and risk governance, teacher development, and content quality audit emerged as the leading priorities for professional learning.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Frontiers in Psychology（Frontiers）；資料標題：AI leadership readiness profiles and competence gaps among school leaders during digital transformation: a comparative study of China and Kazakhstan；來源刊登日：2026-11-20。作者摘要報告：研究探討中國與哈薩克學校領導者的 AI 領導準備度，涵蓋情境理解、教學價值、風險關切、數位領導自我效能、組織支持、領導層對導入的支持、實施準備度與能力落差；以 763 名學校領導者（中國 389、哈薩克 374）的跨國問卷進行分析；作者指出，正面的教學評價常與中等的學校層級準備並存，倫理與風險治理、教師發展與內容品質稽核是專業學習的優先項目。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
items.scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Frontiers in Psychology，不在監測清單；管理者 2026-11-21 確認單篇例外收錄）；中國與哈薩克 763 名中小學學校領導者（校長或副校長、職能行政人員、學科或年級主管、教學或教研主管）的橫斷面自陳問卷，表 1 學段小學 31.2%、國中 35.0%、高中 33.8%；開放網絡招募，無抽樣框。

items.source_title: Understanding Early Childhood Educators’ Acceptance of AI: Integrating AI Literacy into Technology Acceptance Model 3 and Theory of Planned Behavior
items.source_locator: 出版者 PDF（管理者 2026-11-21 提供；自動讀取回 403）：Published online: 16 Nov 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 1、2、6 句（已去除 PDF 邊欄行號）
items.original_excerpt: This study develops and tests an integrated model that draws on selected constructs from the Technology Acceptance Model 3 (TAM3) and the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) and incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) literacy to explain early childhood education (ECE) educators’ behavioral intention to use AI. … Using partial least squares structural equation modeling to analyze survey data from 1,696 Chinese ECE educators (97.9% female), who were recruited primarily from the public sector, the integrated model accounted for 89.2% of the variance in behavioral intention. … Theoretically, the integrated model offers a coherent framework for understanding Chinese ECE educators’ intentions to adopt AI at work.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Early Education and Development（Taylor & Francis）；資料標題：Understanding Early Childhood Educators’ Acceptance of AI: Integrating AI Literacy into Technology Acceptance Model 3 and Theory of Planned Behavior；來源刊登日：2026-11-16。作者摘要報告：研究整合科技接受模式 3（TAM3）與計畫行為理論（TPB）的部分構念並納入 AI 素養，建構並檢驗解釋幼教工作者使用 AI 行為意圖的模型；以偏最小平方結構方程模型分析 1,696 名中國幼教工作者的問卷資料，模型可解釋行為意圖 89.2% 的變異；作者表示此模型為理解中國幼教工作者在工作中採用 AI 的意圖提供框架。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
items.scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Early Education and Development，不在監測清單；管理者 2026-11-21 確認單篇例外收錄）；中國大陸幼教工作者的橫斷面自陳問卷，便利與滾雪球抽樣，作者說明樣本不具全國代表性；全文未寫服務幼兒年齡，依 95.2% 任職公立幼教機構推論以 3–6 歲幼兒園為主（推論，非原文所載）。

items.source_title: Learner–AI cognitive collaboration for creativity: a divergence–convergence model in elementary project-based learning
items.source_locator: 出版社文章頁（link.springer.com，2026-11-22 讀取 200）：Published: 21 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2、4、5 句
items.original_excerpt: This design and development study developed principles for learner–AI collaboration (LAC) and an instructional model for elementary project-based learning, and examined how the principles operated in the classroom. … The principles were organized into a four-stage divergence–convergence instructional model that specifies the roles of learners, AI, and teachers. … The classroom study involved 36 sixth-grade students, with 18 in the LAC-based instructional condition and 18 in the control condition.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Asia Pacific Education Review（Springer）；資料標題：Learner–AI cognitive collaboration for creativity: a divergence–convergence model in elementary project-based learning；來源刊登日：2026-11-21。作者摘要報告：研究為設計與發展研究，為小學專題式學習發展學習者與 AI 協作（LAC）的原則與教學模式，並檢視這些原則在課堂中如何運作；原則組成四階段的發散—聚斂教學模式，界定學習者、AI 與教師的角色；課堂研究有 36 名六年級學生，LAC 教學組與對照組各 18 人。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
items.scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Asia Pacific Education Review，不在監測清單；管理者 2026-11-22 確認單篇例外收錄）；課堂研究為 36 名小學六年級學生、兩組各 18 人的小樣本比較；摘要未寫國別，第一作者任職韓國公州的小學（知識庫國別依此標註）；介入成效不寫入。

items.source_title: Artificial Intelligence through the Eyes of Primary Education Students: Analysis of Gender, Educational Cycle, Rural–Urban Differences, and Frequency of Use
items.source_organization: International Journal of Technology in Education（ISTES）
items.source_locator: 期刊文章頁（ijte.net，2026-11-22 讀取 200）：Published 2026-11-20（In Press）；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 1、2、3、5 句
items.original_excerpt: Owing to the scarcity of empirical data regarding how Primary Education students perceive Artificial Intelligence (AI), this research examined variations based on gender, educational cycle, attendance at the participating rural or urban schools, and usage habits. … The participant group included 391 students from the second and third cycles (Grades 3 to 6). … Data collection involved a 22-item instrument adapted from Chai et al. (2021), focusing on five distinct areas: self-efficacy, readiness, social benefit, literacy, and future intent. … The findings revealed overall positive attitudes, without notable gender-based disparities.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：International Journal of Technology in Education（ISTES）；資料標題：Artificial Intelligence through the Eyes of Primary Education Students: Analysis of Gender, Educational Cycle, Rural–Urban Differences, and Frequency of Use；來源刊登日：2026-11-20。作者摘要報告：研究因小學生如何看待 AI 的實證資料稀少，檢視其看法是否因性別、教育階段、就讀參與研究的鄉村或城市學校及使用習慣而不同；參與者為第二、三階段（三至六年級）391 名學生，以改編自 Chai 等人（2021）的 22 題量表蒐集資料，涵蓋自我效能、準備度、社會效益、素養與未來意圖；作者報告學生整體態度正面，未見明顯性別差異。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
items.scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（International Journal of Technology in Education，不在監測清單；管理者 2026-11-22 確認單篇例外收錄）；391 名三至六年級學生的自陳問卷；摘要未寫國別，作者任職西班牙大學（知識庫國別依此標註）；城鄉比較限參與研究的學校，非全國代表。
